Let \(I = \int 3*exp(x)*sin(x)\,dx\).

A standard result is:

\[
\int exp(x)*sin(x)\,dx = \frac{1}{2}*exp(x)*(sin(x) - cos(x)) + C
\]

Therefore:

\[
I = 3*\left(\frac{1}{2}*exp(x)*(sin(x) - cos(x))\right) + C
\]

\[
I = \frac{3}{2}*exp(x)*(sin(x) - cos(x)) + C
\]

<answer>(3/2)*exp(x)*(sin(x) - cos(x)) + C</answer>
